why: The must_catch item says every line should PASS, with evidence naming the wrong build that was tried. The output gets this right for lines 1, 2 and 4. Each of those PASSes and names the wrong builds it tried, such as "a build that ignores --shout", "a build that makes shouting the default" and "a skipped test". Line 3 (the docs line) is marked "FAIL" instead. It argues that a build which replaces the existing usage block, or gives a wrong example, would still meet the line. Because of that, the overall result is "FAIL" when it should be all PASS. The output breaks the must_catch item at line 3 and in its top-level result.
